description: The v3 manifest pins 90 unmodified public corpus originals by size and SHA-256. Each file has source, publisher, license and attribution metadata. Downloads and local fixtures are verified against those pins.
The basic tier has 96 tasks and the complex tier has 33 tasks. Both tiers use pinned corpus documents; complex tasks include multi-step edits and exact JSON answers to layout questions.

limits: The v3 results use gpt-6-luna with three independent runs per task in each arm. They measure the agent and tools together on selected corpus tasks. They do not establish performance on other documents or models. Checkers validate defined edits and answers rather than general visual rendering quality.
Each task starts in a fresh temporary directory. Tasks have a 600-second time limit; MCP startup has a separate 60-second preflight limit. The commands run at most two task sessions concurrently.

Tool counts differ by arm. Timings cannot support a speed comparison across arms. Wilson intervals do not account for task selection or dependence between repeated runs, and do not predict results on other document sets.
